'''September 2000 Boca Raton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Boca Raton, FL on 17 September 2000. [[Mike Fitzgerald]] won it. It is known from Mike Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1237">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-17-boca-raton-fl-9-17-00d1237/ boca-raton-fl-9-17-00], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 17 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-17-boca-raton-fl-9-17-00d1237/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Boca Raton, FL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Mike Fitzgerald]]
